about_the_game:
"Along the many cloud cities of the Empire Above, there was a metropolis called City of Vapour. Same with some and very different from others..."

Contents

New puzzle series for Mirror Atelier await you in Cloud Machina: City of Vapour! This steampunk metropolis, called "City of Vapour," floats above the skies. Cloud Machina is a world of its own and holds thrilling stories of love, betrayal, and a desperate fight to keep the peace of the whole world.

World

Cloud Machina is a world of steampunk pseudo-science. It is a realm of dreams above the clouds where kind, soft white clouds can turn into a dark, chaotic storm at any moment. Enjoyable new puzzles and stories are awaiting you.

Fable

This fable tells the story of the citizens of Renuva, also known as the "City of Vapour." Dark days are clouding the city's future, and only a few have a chance to change its fate.

Features

  • Discover the stunning visuals of a dreamlike metropolis across every puzzle stage.
  • Uncover the captivating story piece by piece as you complete each stage.
  • The "Cloud Machina" fable includes 3 series of 7 levels each, with every level containing 2 or 3 stages to solve.
  • A 5,000-word narrative filled with intrigue, thrill, love, and more.
  • Enjoy new musics which are specific for this serie.
